A groundbreaking ceremony for https://t.co/EQlraQ8pz8’s Hainan headquarters office project was held in Haikou Jiangdong New Area on September 21. With a total investment of RMB 520 million, including land costs, the project is scheduled for completion in September 2029. It will house https://t.co/EQlraQ8pz8’s businesses in Hainan spanning supply chains, logistics, technology, retail, healthcare and international operations, serving as a strategic base for the company to support the real economy and deepen its presence in Hainan.
#JDcom #HaikouJiangdong #HainanHeadquarters
featured_items.translation_zh:
JD.com 海南总部办公项目奠基仪式于 9 月 21 日在海口江东新区举行。该项目总投资人民币 5.2 亿元（含土地成本），计划于 2029 年 9 月竣工。它将容纳 JD.com 在海南的供应链、物流、科技、零售、医疗健康和国际业务，作为公司支持实体经济并深化在海南布局的战略基地。
#JDcom #HaikouJiangdong #HainanHeadquarters

lead_post.text:
A groundbreaking ceremony for https://t.co/EQlraQ8pz8’s Hainan headquarters office project was held in Haikou Jiangdong New Area on September 21. With a total investment of RMB 520 million, including land costs, the project is scheduled for completion in September 2029. It will house https://t.co/EQlraQ8pz8’s businesses in Hainan spanning supply chains, logistics, technology, retail, healthcare and international operations, serving as a strategic base for the company to support the real economy and deepen its presence in Hainan.
#JDcom #HaikouJiangdong #HainanHeadquarters

lead_post.translation_zh:
JD.com 海南总部办公项目奠基仪式于 9 月 21 日在海口江东新区举行。该项目总投资人民币 5.2 亿元（含土地成本），计划于 2029 年 9 月竣工。它将容纳 JD.com 在海南的供应链、物流、科技、零售、医疗健康和国际业务，作为公司支持实体经济并深化在海南布局的战略基地。
